purpose: 幕1「坑口の森」のマップの下絵（StS2 形の地図。節と道はゲームが上に描く）
deliver: map_act1.png (960x1042 dots, RGBA, 1 dot = 2 screen px)
map_act1_fore.png (optional, 960x1042 RGBA transparent, canopy at the edges only)

canvas.orientation: portrait, scrolls vertically; bottom = start, top = boss
canvas.coords: x from left, y from TOP, in dots

grid_the_game_draws.rows: 16 = 15 rows of nodes + the boss row on top
grid_the_game_draws.note: all in dots. Nodes land by the run's seed, so draw a terrain that works wherever a node sits inside the corridor

corridor.draw: forest floor from above: moss, leaf litter, small clearings, fragments of old paving, fallen logs, a stream may cross it (no bridge needed), low contrast, no bright or white objects

margins.draw: dense conifers, cliffs, roots, fog bands; farther (higher) = bluer and paler

bottom.draw: the trailhead at the edge of the village: a signpost and one lantern post (warm light), path leading up into the forest

top.draw: the mine mouth (坑口): stone gate + winch headframe (巻き上げ機の櫓) seen from above; the boss node sits at x=480 y=73

phone_safe.note: phones see only this band; keep landmarks inside it

style.hand: same artist as the battle stage: HD-2D night forest, lineless pixel art, watercolor picture-book softness but every pixel a square cell at 960x1000
style.light: moonlight from upper-left; fog bands getting brighter toward the top; night blue, darks are navy not black
style.palette: map to docs/pixellab/hd2d-act1/palette-act1.json (48 colors) like the stage art (scripts/stage-palette.py map)
style.camera: near top-down (60-70 deg) map view, trees read as small canopies with short trunks

later: act2 (先代の坑道) and act3 (埋もれた古代都市) with the same spec once act1 is approved
